Panthers Sign Austin Ekeler After Jonathan Brooks Injury

The Carolina Panthers have signed veteran running back Austin Ekeler following an injury to Jonathan Brooks, who has been placed on the injured reserve list. The team is reportedly working out a "2-time NFL TD leader" after this latest setback to Brooks.
